brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust, clearing any obstruction greater than one quarter of the free area before the heat event [SOP-015]. Because the asset has an ONAN cooling system and prior heat-related faults, ensure ambient de-rating rules are followed as detailed in MG-021. The supplied documents do not cover specific operational thresholds for the asset's 19-year age or 6,285 customers served beyond general aging guidance in MG-023.
